verifiedAgainst.note: Every default key below was decoded read-only from the installed game's own binding tables (gcinputbindings_win_keyboard.mbin and gcinputbindings_win_mouse.mbin inside NMSARC.MetadataEtc.pak), in memory, with nothing written to disk. Control labels and hold prompts come from the installed US-English localization tables. The game was not launched.

policy.reason: On the safe-offline allowlist (lead/DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-16). No anti-cheat found: no EasyAntiCheat/BattlEye/other anti-cheat binaries in Binaries\, no anti-cheat disclosure on the Steam store page, Steam Family Sharing allowed, and an official mod switch (GCMODSETTINGS.MXML). Multiplayer is optional co-op with opt-in PvP. Sight never sends input on its own; closed-loop and Sight clicks only answer a user press.

userBindings.summary: In-game rebinds (Options > Controls, per page: On Foot, Flight Controls, Exocraft, Galactic Map, Photo Mode, Building Mode, Menus ...) are saved in the game folder's SETTINGS\GCUSERSETTINGSDATA.MXML under CustomBindingsPC, one entry per changed (action set, action). Only changes are stored; untouched actions keep the packed defaults. Gamepads use Steam Input (native action sets), not this file.

locations.note: Resolve <SteamLibrary> from %ProgramFiles(x86)%\Steam\steamapps\libraryfolders.vdf + appmanifest_275850.acf (default %ProgramFiles(x86)%\Steam). Also holds Hold-to-Confirm (InstantUIInputs, InstantUIDelete), SpaceCombatFollowMode, QuickMenuBuildMenuSwap, TemperatureUnit and HUDZoom, which Prism should read too. Never copy the rest (block list, user names).

Packed DEFAULTS, read-only reference: metadata/input/bindings/gcinputbindings_win_keyboard.mbin and gcinputbindings_win_mouse.mbin. HGPAK v2, zstd chunks of 64 KiB, binary MBIN (GcInputBindings > InputBindingSets[] > InputBindings[] {Action, Axis, Button} as enum ints). Lets a tool refresh defaults after a patch.
Legacy KeyMapping / KeyMapping2 lists; empty on current builds. Ignore unless non-empty.

userBindings.entryShape: Inside <Property name="CustomBindingsPC">, each child is <Property name="CustomBindingsPC" value="GcInputActionMapping2" _index="n"> with four children: ActionSet (e.g. OnFootControls, ShipControls, VehicleMode, GalacticMap, PhotoModeMenu, PhotoModeMvCam, BuildMenuPlacementMode, FRONTEND), Action (GcInputActions name, e.g. Player_Scan), Button (TkInputEnum key name) and Axis (TkInputAxisEnum, 'None' for buttons). The join key is ActionSet + '/' + Action = the verb's appAction.
userBindings.example:
<Property name="CustomBindingsPC" value="GcInputActionMapping2" _index="0">
  <Property name="ActionSet" value="ShipControls" />
  <Property name="Action" value="Ship_Scan" />
  <Property name="Button" value="KeyQ" />
  <Property name="Axis" value="None" />
</Property>
userBindings.keyNameMap: KeyA..KeyZ -> A..Z; Key0..Key9 -> 0..9; Space; Tab; Enter; Escape -> Esc; Backspace; Delete; Insert; Home; End; PageUp; PageDown; Up/Down/Left/Right; F1..F12; LShift/RShift/LCtrl/RCtrl/LAlt/RAlt as is; Shift/Ctrl/Alt (either side) -> Shift/Ctrl/Alt; Comma; Period; Slash; Semicolon; Hyphen -> Minus; Equals -> Equal; LeftSquare -> BracketLeft; RightSquare -> BracketRight; BackSlash -> Backslash; Apostrophe -> Quote; Grave -> Backquote; Hash -> no US equivalent (only VR recenter uses it; ignore). Careful: LeftBracket/RightBracket are '(' and ')', not square brackets. Mouse1 -> left, Mouse2 -> right, Mouse3 -> middle, Mouse4 -> x1, Mouse5 -> x2, MouseWheelUp/MouseWheelDown -> wheelUp/wheelDown (binding kind mouse). KeyboardUnbound / MouseUnbound -> unbound.
userBindings.readMode: Read-only. Watch the SETTINGS folder (the game rewrites the whole file when Options closes); re-parse on change; ignore partial writes (retry after 500 ms). For each verb, if an entry's ActionSet/Action equals its appAction, replace the default chord; if a rebind lands on a key Prism can't send, show the 'unbound' face. Keep defaults if the file can't be parsed.
userBindings.verify: Rebind one key in Options > Controls (e.g. Flight Controls > Perform Scan), close Options, and confirm a new CustomBindingsPC entry appears; then check whether 'Reset to default' deletes it and whether clearing a bind writes KeyboardUnbound.

layouts.rationale: Scan/visor/jetpack on top, Quick Menu and Build (which flip the deck) mid, inventory/map/screenshot at the bottom; survival gauges fill the screen and the survey dial sits on the spare right layer.
Top row = the four most-pressed on-foot keys, bottom row = menus and maps; the strip doubles as a survival readout over the three unused dials.
Flight verbs on top, takeoff/land and weapons mid, maps and Quick Menu at the bottom; target cycling is a dial (push = closest) and the screen is the cockpit gauge cluster.
Same zones squeezed to 4x2 (power, follow and free look drop to page 2); dial 0 cycles targets and the strip shows shield, speed and fuels.
Place/edit/next part on top, snap/color/wiring and camera/axis/delete mid (delete needs a hold), exit-build and inventory at the bottom; rotate and scale are the two dials.
Same build zones in 4x2; rotate (push = axis) and scale (push = snap) on dials 0-1 with counted steps on the strip.
Shoot/hide/camera on top, sun and time presets mid, exit at the bottom; value, category and option rows live on the dials so the effects panel is driven without the mouse.
Photo verbs on the keys; the three dials map value, option row and category so the S+ becomes a photo console.
Warp (hold to confirm) and waypoint on top, home and hide-UI mid, exit at the bottom; navigation mode and filter are dials.
Galaxy actions on the top row, hide-UI and exit below; nav mode and filter on dials 0-1.
When the radial menu opens the deck shows its entries as keys (Sight clicks them), the dial walks the ring with push = select, and back sits bottom-left.
Quick Menu entries on the keys, ring navigation on dial 0 (push = select).

conflicts: Analysis Visor: in-game hint 'Hold <AIM> to use the Analysis Visor' (S3) vs. the PC column of the community table, which lists a plain F press (S9). Pack sends a tap with a whilePressed alternative; verify in game.

Galaxy Map: S9 (2023) lists Q/E for 'Destination' and W/S for 'Filter'; the installed defaults (S1) use Left/Right for navigation mode, Up/Down for filters, WASD to move and Q/E to move down/up. The pack follows S1.
Photo Mode categories: the binding PhotoMode_CatLeft (A) is labeled 'Effects: Next Category' and CatRight (D) 'Effects: Previous Category' in S3. Kept as bound; direction may feel reversed.
Galaxy Map navigation: S1 binds Left = Next Navigation Mode and Right = Previous (looks inverted); the dial maps turn-right to Left so 'right = next'.
gaps: Hold lengths (take off 1500 ms, pulse 1000 ms, build delete 1200 ms, discard 1500 ms) are guesses; the binding data has no durations. Measure in game.

Whether NMS accepts injected input is untested. It reads keyboard/mouse through Raw Input (GetRawInputData in NMS.exe); SendInput scancodes normally reach Raw Input with a null device handle, but this must be tried once in game.

Photo Mode, summon ship/Exocraft/freighter and gestures have NO default key (UI-only Quick Menu items). The pack uses Sight clicks inside the open Quick Menu; the PC 'Quick Bind' (HOTKEY1 & HOTKEY2, wiki says Ctrl + digit) is unverified.

Voice chat has no push-to-talk: GcInputActions has no PTT action and the option text says other players hear you whenever Voice Chat is on. Use Prism's audio module / the user's pinned mic key to mute.
Every Sight region, context detector and readout is unverified until the user's 3440x1440 HDR gameplay recording is calibrated; HUD scale (HUDZoom), UI color scheme and HDR may move or recolor them.
Galaxy Map 'Warp' is Mouse1 only; if it must be held, the schema has no mouse-hold binding.
The exact patch number (7.06 vs a later 7.0x hotfix) isn't in plain text; read it off the title screen.
Game Pass / Microsoft Store and GOG settings paths not probed (only the Steam install is on this PC).
Non-US layouts: the defaults are KeyA..KeyZ names; unclear whether NMS maps them by position (scancode) or character on AZERTY/QWERTZ.
QuickMenuBuildMenuSwap may swap X/Z for keyboard users too; untested.
Photo Mode time-of-day step size (2 min per press per the old wiki) and slider drag support are unverified, so NOON/DUSK may need more than maxSteps 100 presses on the keyboard route.
notes: Anti-cheat: NONE found. No EasyAntiCheat, BattlEye or other anti-cheat files in Binaries\; the Steam store page has no anti-cheat notice; multiplayer runs over PlayFab Party. The game has an official mod switch (GCMODSETTINGS.MXML, DisableAllMods).

Steam Input: the game ships a native Steam Input action manifest (S5), so gamepads are remapped in Steam. Keyboard and mouse are read by the game itself and rebound in Options > Controls (stored in GCUSERSETTINGSDATA.MXML). Steam Input doesn't sit between Prism's injected keys and the game.

appAction format is '<ActionSet>/<Action>' (NMS rebinds are per action set). Where one verb spans several action sets (Quick_Menu, Inventory, SolarSystemMap_ToggleMap), the listed set is the one the join uses.

Hold-to-Confirm option (in Options; exact page unverified): 'Hold for Important' / 'Hold for Destructive' / 'Always Instant', stored as InstantUIInputs + InstantUIDelete. Prism can read them to drop UI holds when the user chose instant.
keyMode scancode: NMS names keys after US positions (KeyA...), uses GLFW (window class GLFW30) and Raw Input.
